# E0356: a normal-form lens is outside what the authoring form expresses

Decompile turns a normal-form lineage back into version files. It expresses
exactly the lenses the compiler produces. A lacuna in the authoring form
describes one field, so a normal-form lacuna over several is outside that, and
Decompile refuses it rather than approximate.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				a: string
			}
		}
	}
	"1": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				a: string
				n: int
			}
		}
	}
}
lenses: {
	"0.0->1.0": {
		v0_0: _
		v1_0: {
			a: v0_0.a
			n: 0
		}
		lacunas: [{
			targetFields: [{path: "a", value: v1_0.a}, {path: "n", value: v1_0.n}]
			message: "n is a placeholder"
			type:    "Placeholder"
		}]
	}
	"1.0->0.0": {
		v1_0: _
		v0_0: {
			a: v1_0.a
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0356]: lens 0.0->1.0 is outside the authoring form: a lacuna over several fields
 --> lineage.cue:1:1
  |
1 | name: "ship"
  | ^^^^
  |
  = help: the authoring form expresses the lenses Compile produces: mappings that copy and compute, and _drop, _coalesce, _match and _each
```
